description: Create a paid short link. Signed in (sign_in token / Bearer; SIGN-IN-WITH-X does not count) or with an agent key (token = ugk_…): FREE within your daily quota (10 a day, 100 on Premium; see get_started), the link and its earnings are your wallet's (an agent key's owner). Anonymous, over quota, or free creation paused: 0.01 USDC via x402: the call returns isError with the PaymentRequired and a code (anonymous, free_quota_exhausted, …) plus nextSteps in _meta["urlgate/payment-error"]; call again with the payment. Limits: 429 rate_limited, 409 duplicate_link, 403 domain_blocked. Payment is ONE signature (no platform-fee leg): sign an accepts[] entry and call again with params._meta["x402/payment"] (PaymentPayload) or paymentSignature (base64). Settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].

paymentSignature.description: MAIN leg: base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for an accepts[] entry (same as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment"], which wins when both are sent. Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.

token.description: Session token (Bearer) when the MCP connection cannot carry an Authorization header
